_doc:
Demo25 (Tsubaki, Hatsumode date) redone the standard layered way (DEMO_DESIGN_GUIDE §6): story unchanged, art = empty plate +
plain-background pose + drawn mouth / blink variants per view. Writes project/web_prompts.json for tools/openai/images.py
(refs d25:<view> = Demo25's flat stills, copied to assets/art/web/d25_<view>.jpg). Run: python3 scripts/prompts.py

bg_torii.prompt:
Image 1 is the reference picture. Remove the young woman completely (and any hand or cup she holds) and fill the space with what is behind her — the same Japanese shrine on New Year's Eve night: snow, lanterns, navy sky, bokeh lights, distant crowd silhouettes — the same composition, colours, lighting and art style. Empty scene, no people.

Wide 16:9 game scene. No text, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI, no readable writing anywhere.

tsubaki_torii.prompt:
Image 1 is the CHARACTER, POSE and STYLE reference: redraw the same young woman in the same pose, size and position in the frame, same art style.

Art style EXACTLY like image 1: soft modern cel animation with a light, airy palette, thin coloured lineart (dark lavender instead of black), flat colours with one soft-edged but still flat shadow tone. Hand-drawn feel, NOT glossy, no bloom. Realistic adult proportions (not chibi).

Tsubaki: the exact young woman from image 1 — very long silver-white hair in a loose low side ponytail tied with a red-and-white braided cord, soft pink-red eyes, a small red camellia pin; a white furisode fading to crimson at the sleeves with red camellias, a gold obi, a white fur stole.

Same pose as image 1: She has just hurried up to you in front of a big red torii gate and stands about one metre away, centre-right of the picture, a little out of breath, one hand raised in a small shy wave, cheeks pink from the cold, a bright happy smile. Warm lantern light on her face. Mouth CLOSED (lips together) in the same expression; full figure as framed in image 1, nothing cut off that image 1 shows.

Plain flat DARK-GREY studio background (#404040), completely empty: no scenery, no snow, no floor line, no shadow on the background. Keep the same lighting on her as in image 1 (warm lantern light, cool night fill).

Wide 16:9 game scene. No text, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI, no readable writing anywhere.

tsubaki_torii_talk.prompt: Edit this exact image. Keep EVERYTHING identical — same pose, hands, framing, size, position, hair strands, clothes, colours, lighting and background — and change ONLY her mouth: slightly open as if talking softly, a small natural opening, no teeth showing. Do not move, zoom or crop the picture.

tsubaki_torii_blink.prompt: Edit this exact image. Keep EVERYTHING identical — same pose, hands, framing, size, position, hair strands, clothes, colours, lighting and background — and change ONLY her eyes: closed in a natural blink (eyelids down, lashes visible); her bangs stay exactly as they are. Do not move, zoom or crop the picture.
